title: Consolidation of a group (PRD-001 FR-ENT-06, RND-TRANSLATE)
description: One case both implementations must reproduce. Each entity's lines are the net monthly movement of an account of the parent's chart, in the entity's currency, a debit positive, from its books' start through the run's last month; counterparty names the other entity of an intercompany account. Translation: an asset or liability at the closing rate of the last month on its cumulative balance, once; an equity account each month's movement at that month's closing rate; a revenue or expense each month's movement at that month's average rate (section result from the run's first month on, brought_forward before it); every translated amount rounded once to the group currency's minor units, half away from zero; an entity in the group currency is not translated; a translated line of nothing is not listed; the translation reserve of an entity is the negative sum of its translated lines. A pair's a normally holds a debit and its b a credit: for two entities the smaller of x (the first's a, the second its counterparty) and -y (the second's b) is eliminated from both when x is above nothing and y below nothing; a gap x + y of anything but nothing is listed and nothing is plugged. Flat forms: entity line account|counterparty|section|amount; elimination entity|account|counterparty|section|amount; difference debit_entity|credit_entity|a|b|x|y|matched|gap; consolidated account|section|amount; each list sorted as text, amounts at the group currency's minor units.
